mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_environment_variable_ref (tenant_id, agent_version_id, environment_variable_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{agentVersionId}, #{environmentVariableId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_environment_variable_ref WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND agent_version_id = #{agentVersionId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, agent_version_id, environment_variable_id, gmt_create FROM agent_environment_variable_ref WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND agent_version_id = #{agentVersionId} ORDER BY environment_variable_id, id

SELECT ref.tenant_id AS refTenantId, ref.agent_version_id AS agentVersionId, ref.environment_variable_id AS environmentVariableId, ev.id AS variableId, ev.tenant_id AS variableTenantId, ev.name, ev.credential_ref AS credentialRef FROM agent_environment_variable_ref ref LEFT JOIN environment_variable ev ON ev.id = ref.environment_variable_id AND ev.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ev.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ref.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ref.agent_version_id = #{agentVersionId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN ev.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ev.name, ref.environment_variable_id, ref.id
